title: Block chain-based federal learning method, device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: Shanghai Dianrong Information Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: Complexity in implementing a federal learning platform, lack of trusted certificate storage and traceability, and risk of acquiring or leaking intermediate training models by aggregation server
pse.solution_function: Creates a sub account book for each federated learning instance, stores participant node's training data locally, calls a smart contract-based training algorithm on each participant node to train a model, and encrypts the intermediate training model
pse.solution_structure: Business layer, sub account book, private data storage area in participant nodes, smart contract-based training algorithms on participant nodes
pse.solution_implementation: Upon federated learning instance start, a sub account book is created. The business layer sends training data and corresponding smart contracts to each participant node. Each participant node stores the data locally, calls their respective smart contract to train a model, and encrypts the intermediate model
pse.effect: Simplifies complexity in implementing federal learning platforms, enables trusted certificate storage and traceability, reduces risk of intermediary training model acquisition or leakage
